name: a lone character tips and falls into its place
looks: A single small block character tips off balance against a dark, bokeh-lit background, its face anxious, then falls and tumbles down out of frame before the next shot picks it up settled into its spot.
build: squash-stretch-ball-demo, applied to the character: the tip is a slow rotation past its balance point on power1.in, the fall uses real gravity, and a light motion blur sells the speed; the character squashes slightly on the implied landing in the next cut.
sound: A rising whoosh through the fall, a soft thump as it lands off-screen.
prompt: Let a single small character lose its balance and tip over, then fall with real gravity and a touch of motion blur against a dark, softly lit background, its expression carrying the emotion of the moment. Use it as the turning point just before the piece finds where it belongs.
